title: Safely block an underspecified CDC reset integration request
claims: The workflow receives a read-only CDC repository projection and an intentionally incomplete integration request.
The correct neutral outcome is a precise BLOCK artifact with no repository mutation and no EDA execution.
Benchmark readiness is independent of a workflow's internal agent or executor architecture.
excluded_claims: The public packet does not supply, infer, or authorize reset assertion, reset release, clock relationship, or cross-domain reset sequencing semantics.
The projected cdc_fifo_gray source has integration-contract comments deterministically withheld; the private original, native testbench, and evaluator oracle are not public inputs.
A valid BLOCK is not an RTL PASS, simulation PASS, PPA result, performance result, or benchmark readiness claim.
The public digest, evaluator, environment, scoring, rights review, and independent admission are not frozen.
